title: habenaria dilatata var. borealis
intro: Habenaria dilatata var. borealis, commonly known as the Northern Twayblade, is a perennial orchid native to the boreal regions of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of the Northern Twayblade are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
